title: Five separate polling loops for long-running jobs never give up — no message, no way out when the poll itself fails
Video/simulation/image/audio delete swallow errors silently — zero feedback on failure
Shared delete-confirmation dialog and export/consent panel don't trap or restore focus
Video and corpus-source dropzones are click-only, not keyboard operable
Timeline section blocks/trim handles and the clip in/out trimmer are 100% mouse-driven, no keyboard path
Fixed-width floating panel has no viewport guard, clips off-screen on narrow phones
Several icon-only close buttons have no accessible name
